 See the latest rain totals near you. 
 Updated: 4:48 PM PST Nov 16, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Daniel Macht Digital Media Manager Sierra ski resorts received another 8 inches to 18 inches of new snow on Sunday through Monday morning. 
 Hearst Owned That comes on top of another foot of snow the resorts added from Friday into Saturday, according to our weather team. 
 Advertisement As for rain totals, the Sacramento area received 0.71 inches of new rain from Sunday through Monday. Stockton got 0.73 inches and Modesto received 0.64. 
 Oroville received 2.28 inches of new rainfall.
